name: Power Supply Unit Assembly
description: Main 24V DC power supply assembly providing regulated power to all subsystems. Includes EMI filtering, over-voltage protection, and thermal management components.

name: Main Controller Board Assembly
description: Central logic controller housing the primary MCU, CAN bus interface, and digital I/O expansion headers. Designed for DIN rail mounting in industrial enclosures.

name: Sensor Module Housing
description: IP67-rated enclosure assembly for field-mounted sensor electronics. Includes gland entries, internal PCB mounting bracket, and conduit knockout provisions.

name: RF Shield Assembly
description: Multi-piece RF shielding assembly for the receiver front-end section. Fabricated from 0.5 mm cold-rolled steel with tin plating for solderability and corrosion resistance.

name: Battery Compartment Assembly
description: Sealed battery compartment supporting 4x AA cells in series-parallel configuration. Features spring-loaded contacts, polarity protection PCB, and a captive cover with O-ring seal.

name: Front Control Panel
description: Operator interface panel assembly integrating membrane keypad, LED status indicators, and a 2.4-inch TFT display. Designed for flush mounting in a 2 mm aluminium front plate.

name: Cooling System Assembly
description: Active cooling assembly consisting of a 92 mm PWM fan, aluminium heat sink, and thermal interface pad. Configured for forced-air cooling of the motor drive power stage.

name: Motor Drive Enclosure
description: Sheet metal enclosure for the 3-phase motor drive electronics, rated IP54. Includes DIN rail provisions, cable management channels, and removable top cover for service access.

name: Signal Conditioning Module
description: Analog signal conditioning assembly accepting 4–20 mA and 0–10 V field inputs. Provides galvanic isolation, scaling, and filtering prior to ADC sampling.

name: Antenna Mount Assembly
description: Adjustable antenna mounting bracket assembly for external panel installation. Supports antenna rotation up to 360° and tilt ±45°, fabricated from 3 mm 6061-T6 aluminium.

name: LED Display Module
description: Legacy 7-segment LED display module superseded by ASM-006. Retained for spare parts supply to existing installed base. No new design-ins permitted.

name: Connector Interface Board
description: I/O interface board providing field-wiring terminal blocks, D-sub breakouts, and ESD protection for all external signal connections entering the main enclosure.
